attributes.headline: Password Reset Guide
attributes.body:
If you cannot sign in and you use a password rather than single sign-on, you can reset it yourself.

1. Go to the sign-in page and choose **Forgot password**.
2. Enter the email address on your account.
3. Open the link we send you — it is valid for one hour.
4. Choose a new password.

If the email does not arrive within ten minutes, check your spam folder, then write to us and we will send it again.
